about: The plain names of well-known lakes whose OpenStreetMap name cannot simply lose its word for lake, read by tools/map/lake-names.mjs when the water block is packed. A lake's label is just its name, without the word for lake (Ignas, 11 October 2026): where OSM writes the name as a genitive (Lithuanian Platelių ežeras, the lake of Plateliai; Latvian Rāznas ezers) or an adjective (Russian Онежское озеро), and the lake's own OSM tags do not give the plain name in a form the rules can match, this list does. Every other such lake keeps its full name with the word for lake written out. Genitives are never turned into nominatives by a rule on endings: Lithuanian and Latvian endings are too ambiguous for that.
fields: lang: the language of the name (lt, lv, ru, ...). name: the name without the word for lake, as OSM writes it (before romanising). plain: the name the label shows (before romanising). toCheck: true where the plain form is the author's knowledge and not in the lake's own OSM data; check it against a gazetteer before relying on it. why: where the plain form comes from.

entries.name: Онежское
entries.why: Lake Onega: OSM's alt_name is Онего, which the rule on shared letters cannot match (Онег- and Онеж- share only three)

entries.name: Platelių
entries.why: Lake Plateliai (Samogitia): Platelių is the genitive of Plateliai

entries.name: Rėkyvos
entries.why: Lake Rėkyva (by Šiauliai): Rėkyvos is the genitive of Rėkyva

entries.name: Asvejos
entries.why: Lake Asveja (Dubingiai): Asvejos is the genitive of Asveja; the lake's OSM name:lv tag is Asveja

entries.name: Vištyčio
entries.why: Lake Vištytis (on the border with the Kaliningrad region): Vištyčio is the genitive of Vištytis; the lake's OSM name:lv (Vištītis ezers) and name:et (Vištytise järv) agree

entries.name: Lūksto
entries.why: Lake Lūkstas (Telšiai district): Lūksto is the genitive of Lūkstas

entries.name: Rubikių
entries.why: Lake Rubikiai (Anykščiai district): Rubikių is the genitive of Rubikiai

entries.name: Širvėnos
entries.why: Lake Širvėna (Biržai): Širvėnos is the genitive of Širvėna

entries.name: Rāznas
entries.why: Lake Rāzna (Latgale): Rāznas is the genitive of Rāzna; the lake's OSM name:be is Разна

entries.name: Usmas
entries.why: Lake Usma (Courland): Usmas is the genitive of Usma

entries.name: Liepājas
entries.why: Lake Liepāja: Liepājas is the genitive of Liepāja (the lake is named after the town)

entries.name: Babītes
entries.why: Lake Babīte (west of Riga): Babītes is the genitive of Babīte

entries.name: Engures

entries.why: Lake Alūksne: Alūksnes is the genitive of Alūksne (the lake and the town share the name)
